# Stuart J. Green

> Operating Model Advisor to boards and CEOs navigating irreversible change. Anti-Resilience Strategist. Author of The Regenerate Leap. Founder of Blue-Green Advisors. Applies three decades of marine systems science to organisations where the previous model is structurally obsolete and there is no prior state worth restoring.

Core position: Resilience is a trap. Regeneration is a strategy. Resilience aims to restore a prior state and optimises for stability. Regeneration assumes the prior state is gone and redesigns the system for the conditions that now hold.

## Key facts

- Name: Stuart J. Green (also searched as Stuart Green)
- Role: Operating Model Advisor; founder of Blue-Green Advisors
- Book: The Regenerate Leap. Leap forward. Grow through fire. (Blue-Green Advisors Ltd, 16 January 2026, ISBN 9798261936251)
- The Regenerate Leap is a business book for CEOs, founders, senior executives, and board members. Its subjects: crisis leadership, organisational change, business turnaround, and decision making under sustained pressure.
- Framework: REGENERATE. Three phases, ten steps. RAZE (Recognise, Embrace, Ground), ENRICH (Empower, Navigate, Equip, Reframe), GROW (Adapt, Transform, Evolve).
- Diagnostic: a thirteen-question instrument scoring the misfit between an operating model and current conditions. Five minutes. https://theregenerateframework.com
- An operating model misfit is the gap between how an organisation is structured to work and the conditions it now operates in.
